spans.s:
mar-a, m. dying, death;
 world of death, 🞄earth: -ka, m. plague, epidemic.
marakata, n. emerald: -maya, a. 🞄formed of emeralds.
mārakata, a. (ī) emerald-like: -tva, 🞄n. emerald colour.
maranda, m. (?) flower-juice.
mara‿ārāma, m. N. of a Daitya.
marāla, a. m., i-kā, f. kind of goose, 🞄swan, or duck.

marica, m. pepper-shrub;
 N..
mārica, a. made of pepper: with 🞄cūrṇa, a. ground pepper.
marīc-in, m. (radiant), sun.
marut-a, m. wind.
marū-bhū, become a sandy waste.
1. marká, m. eclipse of the sun (RV.¹).

2. márka, m. N. of the Purohita of the 🞄Asuras;
 N. of a demon hostile to children.

markáṭa, m. ape, monkey: ī, f. female 🞄ape;
 a-ka, m., i-kā, f. id..
mārkaṭa, a. (ī) belonging to the 🞄monkey, ape-like.
markaṭī-bhū, turn into an ape.
marḍ-i-tṛ́, m. shower of compassion, 🞄comforter (RV.).
már-ta, m. [old pp. of √ mṛ, preserving 🞄original strong vowel owing to early shifting 🞄of accent caused by change of meaning] 🞄mortal, man (V.).
mar-tavya, fp. n. imps. one must die.
mard-ala, m. kind of drum.

már-man, n. joint, exposed or vital part 🞄of the body;
 weak or vulnerable spot (fig.).

mar-mar-a, a. rustling (leaves or garments);
 🞄m. rustling, murmur.
marma-rāja, m. N..
marmarā-ya, den. Ā. rustle, murmur.
marmarī-bhū, begin to murmur: 🞄pp. -bhūta, murmuring.

marma‿atiga, a. penetrating deep 🞄into the joints or vitals, excruciating;
 -āvaraṇa, n. coat of mail.
marmā-vidh, a. piercing a vital 🞄spot, very cutting (speech).

maryād-in, m. frontier neighbour;
 🞄a. keeping within bounds.
maryādī-kṛ, make a limit of, 🞄extend to (ac.).

marś-ana, n. touching;
 investigating.
māra-ripu, m. foe of the Devil, 🞄ep. of Śiva (Pr.).
mārav-a, a. (ī) forming or situated 🞄in a desert (maru).
mār-ikā, f. plague, pestilence.
māriṣa, m. [perhaps turned back 🞄into Sanskrit from the Pāli mārisa = mādṛśa] 🞄worthy or excellent man (nearly always used 🞄in the vc. as a term of address = my worthy 🞄friend).
mār-īya, a. belonging to the god of 🞄love.
mā́ru-ka, a. perishing.
mārut-i, m. pat. fr. Marut, ep. of 🞄Hanumat and Bhīma.
mārutī, f. (sc. diś) north-west.

mārkaṇḍeya, m. pat. son of 🞄Mṛkaṇḍa, N. of an ancient sage: pl. his 🞄descendants;
 a. composed by Mārkaṇḍeya: 🞄-purāṇa, n. T. of a Purāṇa.
mārgava, m. a mixed caste (offspring 🞄of a Niṣāda and an Āyogava woman).
mārgav-eya, m. pat. or met. of a Rāma.
mārg-āl-ī, f. track.
mārga‿avalokin, a. scanning 🞄the road, anxiously expectant.
mārga‿īśa, m. road-keeper.
mārga‿upadiś, m. pointer out 🞄of the way, guide.

mārj-āl-ī́ya, a. fond of being 🞄cleansed;
 m. mound to the right of the Vedi 🞄on which the sacrificial utensils are cleansed.
mārj-ita, (cs.) pp. cleansed etc. 🞄(√ mṛj).
mārḍ-īká, n. [√ mṛd] compassion, 🞄mercy.

mārtaṇḍa, m. (late form of V. mārtāṇḍa) 🞄bird in the sky, sun, sun-god;
 statue 🞄of the sun-god: -maṇḍala, n. disc of the sun.
mārtaṇḍ-īya, a. solar.

mārtti-ka, a. (ī) made of clay, 🞄earthen;
 n. earthenware vessel.
mārdaṅg-ika, m. drummer.
mārṣa, m. worthy man (only as a 🞄term of address in vc. = māriṣa).
mārṣ-ṭavya, fp. [√ mṛj] to be 🞄cleansed or swept.
